featured_reviews.name: chirag shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience with Papubhai.

We placed an order for fabric and were clearly promised delivery within 2–3 days. Based on this assurance, we made the full advance payment. Unfortunately, even after 7–10 days, the fabric has still not been delivered, and we are being made to continuously follow up without any clear resolution.

While Papubhai may be a large seller, in our experience the commitment to delivery and reliability was very poor. Business runs on trust, and when advance payment is taken, timely delivery becomes the seller’s responsibility.

I strongly advise future buyers to avoid full advance payments and ensure firm delivery commitments before proceeding.

This review is shared only to help others make informed business decisions.

I bought tissue silk worth ₹2000, and at no point was I informed that the fabric **cannot be ironed** and **wrinkles badly**, making it look poorly maintained. When the wrinkles didn’t ease out and I sent it to the dhobi (a completely reasonable step), the owner’s response was rude and dismissive: *“Who told you to give it to the dhobi?”* followed by *“It’s common sense, whole India is using this tissue since 3 years.”* Instead of taking responsibility for poor guidance, the store chose arrogance over customer care. Zero accountability, zero professionalism. Would not recommend.
